title: Propensity-Score Matching
summary: A mentored causal-inference analysis on restricted-access vital-statistics data, run in a secure computing environment, supporting a manuscript in preparation.
overview: A mentored causal-inference analysis using restricted-access vital-statistics data in a secure computing environment. The work emphasizes reproducible, well-documented analytic workflows and is being packaged for a manuscript in preparation.
myRole: I designed and implemented the analytic workflow end to end, with documented assumptions, reproducible code, and careful handling of restricted data.

sections.title: Rigor & Reproducibility
content: Worked within the constraints of a secure, restricted-data environment, with a disk-frugal pipeline and per-output persistence.
Documented assumptions, exclusions, and analytic decisions to support transparent, reviewable work.
Coordinated with a faculty mentor toward a manuscript in preparation.

outcomes: Built a reproducible, well-documented analytic pipeline within a secure restricted-data environment.
Packaged methods toward a manuscript in preparation.
